title: Register on the YHM website
body: Registration for YHM 2027 is open at www.yavatmalhealthmarathon.com. Early bird: 25% off till 30 November 2026.

title: Race date and venue
body: Yavatmal Health Marathon 2027, 5th edition: Sunday 3 January 2027 at Nehru Stadium, Godhani Road, Yavatmal.

title: Dose-T is our Training Partner
body: Dose-T is the official Training Partner for YHM 2027.
